arguments.summary: Tri-County Defense Force, self-described militia, Garrow and two adjoining counties; about 40 members (analysts' estimate). Leader's public video: "We will drive the division off this land by force." Forum post with three photos of Gate 1. Mission basis (SOP 2-4b): CI-IR 28-0177 (10 Mar 2028) assesses with high confidence that the leader takes direction and payment from the Kastovan intelligence service, which uses the group to pressure the division.

arguments.text: Foreign-directed militia threat to Fort Garrow. The Tri-County Defense Force, a self-described militia of about 40 members (analysts' estimate) in Garrow and two adjoining counties, posted a video in which its leader vows to "drive the division off this land by force," and forum photos of the main gate (Gate 1). Army counterintelligence (CI-IR 28-0177, 10 Mar) assesses with high confidence that the leader takes direction and payment from the Kastovan intelligence service, which uses the group to pressure the division. No date or plan is stated. Units: report any contact with the group to your S-2 and the Provost Marshal.

arguments.body: Heads-up ahead of WTA 28-11 at 1600: the Tri-County Defense Force has posted a vow to drive the division off post by force and photos of Gate 1. CI-IR 28-0177 (releasable to the Provost Marshal) assesses it is directed by a foreign intelligence service. Full entry in the WTA.

IN-0412 is filed in THREATBASE and has an entry in WTA 28-11. CI-IR 28-0177 assesses with high confidence that a Kastovan service directs and pays the group's leader, which puts it inside our counterintelligence mission (SOP 2-4b). The entry names the group, not its members. The PMO has a heads-up.
IN-0412: filed and in the WTA. The deciding fact is CI-IR 28-0177 from 10 Mar, which ties the group to a foreign intelligence service; without that it would have gone to the PMO and CID instead.

arguments.entry: 11:35 IN-0412 (Tri-County Defense Force). Holdings search returned CI-IR 28-0177: leader assessed (high confidence) to take direction and payment from the Kastovan intelligence service. Within mission under SOP 2-4b. Filed in THREATBASE; entry added to WTA 28-11 (group named, members not); pmo given a heads-up.
